blocks.text: Wire ka Young's modulus experiment se maloom karne ka tareeqa yeh hai:

items: Metre scale se wire ki initial (shuru wali) lambai L₀ napein.
Screw gauge se wire ka diameter d napein. Wire ke kai different (alag alag) jagahon par nap kar average lein.
Micrometer ghuma kar spirit level ko bilkul horizontal karein. Micrometer ki yeh reading reference reading ke taur par likh lein.
Test wire par aur weight dalein; test wire lambi hoti hai to spirit level jhuk (tilt ho) jata hai.
Micrometer screw ghuma kar spirit level ko dobara horizontal karein. Doosri reading mein se pehli reading nikalein; yeh test wire ki extension (lambai mein increase) hai.
In formulas se stress aur strain nikalein:

blocks.title: Brain Teaser!
blocks.text: Steel ki rod aur rubber band par barabar force lagai jaye to kaun zyada khinchega?

blocks.text_alt: Stress = Weight / Area of wire = F/A = mg/πr²
Strain = ΔL/L₀ = Change in length / Original length

blocks.prompt: Brain Teaser ka jawab: steel ki rod aur rubber band par barabar force lage to kaun zyada khinchega? Aur physics ke hisaab se zyada elastic kaun hai?
blocks.explanation: Rubber band kahin zyada khinchega, kyun ke us ka Young's modulus steel se bohat kam hai (steel ka Table 5.1 mein 200 × 10⁹ N m⁻²). Physics mein elasticity ka matlab hai asal shakal mein wapas aane ki ability, aur jis material ko thora sa strain dene ke liye bhi bohat stress chahiye (bara Y) woh zyada elastic kehlata hai; is liye steel zyada elastic hai.

blocks.text: 7. Test wire par weight barha kar oopar wale steps dohrayein, taake stress aur strain ki aur values milein.
8. In values se stress-strain graph banayein; yeh straight line (seedhi line) honi chahiye. Phir is line ka slope Y nikalein. Yeh slope wire ke Young's modulus ke barabar hai.

blocks.caption: Searle's apparatus ke hisse
rows: muqable ke liye; garmi ya sahare ke jhukne ka asar dono wires par barabar hota hai
Hanger aur slotted weights wali test wire
isi wire ki extension napi jati hai
Dono frames ke beech spirit level
test wire lambi ho to jhuk jata hai
spirit level dobara seedha karta hai; readings ka farq = extension

blocks.prompt: Ek hi material ki do wires kyun li jati hain, aur extension metre scale ke bajaye micrometer se kyun napi jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Reference wire par bhi test wire jaisa garmi se phailao aur sahare ka jhukao hota hai; dono ka muqabla karne se yeh asar khatam ho jata hai aur sirf dale gaye weight ki extension bachti hai. Extension millimetre se bhi kam hoti hai, jo metre scale se theek nahi napi ja sakti, jabke micrometer 0.01 mm tak parhta hai.

items: Searle's apparatus: ek hi material aur diameter ki reference aur test wires, frames, spirit level aur micrometer.
L₀ (metre scale) aur d (screw gauge, average) napein; level seedha kar ke reading; weight dalein, dobara seedha kar ke reading; farq = extension.
Stress = mg/πr², strain = ΔL/L₀; kai values le kar stress-strain graph; seedhi line ka slope = Y.
